entries.wording: Die Daten zu Ihrer Sendung wurden an uns übermittelt. Die Weiterverarbeitung folgt.
entries.note: IDS's FAQ quotes it as a tracking status and explains it. IDS has the order data; the pickup from the seller follows. The tracking page shows the same sentence for a lookup without any data, an unknown number or postcode included.
